links.outcome: Readability, understandability and actionability of AI-generated pediatric postoperative instructions against adequacy thresholds
links.effect: ChatGPT best readability (FKRE 64.57, FKGL 7.40); Gemini understandability 83.20%; DeepSeek actionability 71.10%. No platform met FKGL <6, FKRE >60 and PEMAT-P >80% at once.
links.quote: No AI platform met all the adequacy thresholds (FKGL <6, FKRE >60, PEMAT-P > 80%) at one time.

links.outcome: Reading grade level of AI-generated patient instructions relative to target level
links.effect: Best FKGL was 7.40 (±1.54) for ChatGPT, above the FKGL <6 adequacy threshold; no platform met all thresholds.
links.quote: No AI platform met all the adequacy thresholds (FKGL <6, FKRE >60, PEMAT-P > 80%) at one time.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation benchmarking the readability, understandability, and actionability of patient postoperative instructions generated by three LLMs (ChatGPT, Gemini, DeepSeek) for pediatric ORL surgeries using standardized prompts, without testing specific deployment safeguards or practices.
